07 · Explicit save & remove
Save and Remove retain displayed intent. Already-present Save and already-absent Remove make zero writes. Preserve saved_at, issue_evidence and unrelated parsed entries; Remove deletes every exact revision match. Only a new Save applies the existing 50-record retention policy; opaque entries survive. Read/parse/shape failure prevents mutation. One write requires exact serialized readback.
